summary.text: Alexandra Macedo is a Republican member of the California State Assembly representing District 33; she assumed office on December 2, 2024, and began serving as minority leader of the Assembly in August 2026.

paragraphs.text: She was born in Tulare, California, graduated from Tulare Union High School, and earned a bachelor's degree in business law from California State University and a law degree from the San Joaquin College of Law in 2021.
Her career experience includes serving as president of Macedo Environmental Consulting, Inc.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
